$comment: Per-field rules, source-authority hierarchy, and status policy. Recency applies only within the same tier: a newer brochure never beats a higher-tier source (contract, official register, signed spec, signed price list). The engine ships with matching defaults.

source_tiers.name: signed_legal
source_tiers.notes: Signed legal instrument: current title, lease, sale contract, reservation agreement.

source_tiers.name: official_register
source_tiers.notes: Current official register extract, always with the register's date. Price Paid tenure is as at the sale date and may lag a later private transaction — mark 'check this', do not auto-correct.

source_tiers.name: signed_spec
source_tiers.notes: Latest signed specification or measured survey, with the basis stated (NIA, GIA, or other).

source_tiers.name: price_list
source_tiers.notes: Latest signed price list or formal developer instruction.

source_tiers.name: brochure
source_tiers.notes: Latest marketing brochure or formal particulars. Recency applies within this tier (Kelso October 2026 sits above April 2026, same issuer).

source_tiers.name: listing
source_tiers.notes: Lowest tier. Useful as a prompt to check, not as a value to quote.

price.label: Price
price.notes: Most recent brochure or price list in-tier wins as the candidate. Price is material, so status stays pending until a human signs it off. Official last-sold (Price Paid) is historical: SUPERSEDED by time, not a current asking price. A listing at an old figure is STALE_LISTING and is flagged for update.

tenure.label: Tenure
tenure.precedence_tier_notes: Current title (tier 1) and official register (tier 2). Do not auto-correct an official-record mismatch — mark 'check this' and require human sign-off. Peer listings that disagree are a true conflict.
tenure.notes: A newer brochure never beats a current title or official register.

net_floor_area.label: Net floor area (NIA)
net_floor_area.notes: Keep NIA and GIA as separate resolved facts. Prefer the source that states both figures consistently. A wrong sq m ↔ sq ft conversion is a document error (UNIT_MISMATCH), not two areas.

gross_floor_area.label: Gross floor area (GIA)
gross_floor_area.notes: Kept separate from net floor area.

floor_area.label: Floor area
floor_area.notes: If area_basis is set, the fact is grouped with net_floor_area or gross_floor_area.

energy_rating.label: Energy rating (EPC)
energy_rating.notes: EPC register (official_record) is the authoritative source for the rating and certificate date.

parking.label: Parking
parking.notes: Lease, title or deed of grant, and the allocation schedule sit above a brochure, which sits above a listing.
